name: Wrecking Ball

specialAbility.name: Demolition
specialAbility.description: Swings a giant wrecking ball that smashes right through shields like they're made of cardboard!

lore: Built from the scraps of an old demolition yard, Wrecking Ball doesn't need fancy tricks — just pure smashing power! Its giant steel frame barrels through anything in its path, and when it swings its signature wrecking ball attack, even the toughest shields crumble like cookies!
